title: KodCode: A Diverse, Challenging, and Verifiable Synthetic Dataset for Coding
authors_zh: Zhangchen Xu、Yang Liu、Yueqin Yin、Mingyuan Zhou、Radha Poovendran
paper_type_zh: 可执行校验的合成编程数据集与推理 SFT 配方
best_for_zh: 适合构造单元测试验收的编程 SFT/RL 数据，或审计同源生成的答案与测试。
one_line: KodCode releases large CC BY-NC coding triplets and 268,211 verified R1-SFT records with tests, trial statistics, difficulty, and contamination fields.
KodCode 公开大规模 CC BY-NC 编程三元组与 268,211 条经单元测试验收的 R1-SFT 记录，并保留试验、难度和污染字段。
why: It makes both synthetic-code supervision and its executable acceptance evidence inspectable across twelve source families and several difficulty bands.
inclusion_reason: KodCode publishes verified DeepSeek-R1 reasoning/code conversations and their question-solution-test lineage as direct SFT targets, with executable checks and failure splits rather than only an RL environment.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Human-curated code datasets provide trustworthy tasks but do not scale, while large synthetic collections often trade away domain diversity, problem difficulty, or executable correctness. A generated solution that passes tests written by the same model can still be wrong, and simple rejection sampling disproportionately removes hard questions.

KodCode synthesizes twelve question families, repeatedly regenerates both solution and unit tests until they execute with full branch coverage, and converts verified triplets into multiple task styles. DeepSeek-R1 then writes three candidate reasoning responses per question, and paired tests select the SFT targets; the paper version contains 447K verified triplets.

L4 facts: primary source Findings of ACL 2025, pages 6980-7008, https://aclanthology.org/2025.findings-acl.365/; open data KodCode-V1 and KodCode-V1-SFT-R1 are public Parquet releases under CC BY-NC 4.0; construction, schemas, execution contract, split/version differences, adoption, and benchmark evidence are verified.

人工整理的编程数据可靠但难以扩展，大型合成数据则往往牺牲领域多样性、题目难度或可执行正确性。同一个模型生成的答案与测试即使彼此一致也可能共同出错，而简单 rejection sampling 还会不成比例地删除高难问题。

KodCode 合成十二类问题，反复重新生成答案与单元测试，直到它们能执行并达到完整分支覆盖，再把通过验收的三元组转换成多种任务格式。DeepSeek-R1 为每题编写三份候选推理回答，配套测试负责选择 SFT target；论文版本共有 447K 条已验证三元组。

L4 事实：主要来源为 Findings of ACL 2025 第 6980-7008 页，https://aclanthology.org/2025.findings-acl.365/；KodCode-V1 与 KodCode-V1-SFT-R1 是采用 CC BY-NC 4.0 的公开 Parquet 数据；构造、schema、执行契约、split/版本差异、使用信号与 benchmark 证据均已核对。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
KodCode treats a coding demonstration as a question-solution-test record with visible generation trials, coverage, difficulty, and lineage, then adds a test-accepted DeepSeek-R1 reasoning response for SFT. GPT-4o regenerates both solution and tests up to ten times so hard questions are not rejected after one failure, while program execution and 100% branch coverage decide acceptance; this Card therefore belongs to instruction/demonstration/rationale data, although the same tests can also support RLVR.

Google Scholar citations: 89（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=KodCode%3A+A+Diverse%2C+Challenging%2C+and+Verifiable+Synthetic+Dataset+for+Coding&author=Zhangchen+Xu&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes. Dataset names: KodCode-V1 and KodCode-V1-SFT-R1. Official URLs: https://huggingface.co/datasets/KodCode/KodCode-V1 and https://huggingface.co/datasets/KodCode/KodCode-V1-SFT-R1. Scale: paper V1 has 447K triplets; current V1.1 exposes 484,097 train plus 3,335 caution records, and R1-SFT exposes 268,211 verified train, 210,787 incorrect, and 4,439 caution records. Record form: version/style/subset/question ID, question, canonical solution, tests and function metadata, GPT trial/pass/difficulty fields, R1 trial/pass/solution fields, conversations, lineage metadata, benchmark similarity, and caution reason. File/storage format: sharded Parquet. Domains/languages: English Python tasks across twelve families from basic functions to competitive programming and package documentation. Construction and filtering: multiple generators write questions, GPT-4o writes solution-test pairs, pytest/stdio execution plus branch coverage verifies them, and tests reject failing R1 responses. License/access constraints: public and ungated CC BY-NC 4.0; code is Apache-2.0 and upstream seed terms require review. Intended use: SFT and test-reward RL.

KodCode 把编程示范写成带生成试验、覆盖率、难度和 lineage 的问题、答案、测试记录，再为 SFT 加入经测试验收的 DeepSeek-R1 推理回答。GPT-4o 最多重新生成十组答案与测试，使高难问题不会因首次失败就被删除；程序执行和 100% 分支覆盖决定是否接受。因此本 Card 属于指令、示范与理由数据，虽然相同测试也可用于 RLVR。

Google Scholar 引用数：89（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=KodCode%3A+A+Diverse%2C+Challenging%2C+and+Verifiable+Synthetic+Dataset+for+Coding&author=Zhangchen+Xu&hl=en）

开源数据：有。数据集名称：KodCode-V1 与 KodCode-V1-SFT-R1。官方地址：https://huggingface.co/datasets/KodCode/KodCode-V1 和 https://huggingface.co/datasets/KodCode/KodCode-V1-SFT-R1。规模：论文 V1 有 447K 条三元组；当前 V1.1 公开 484,097 条 train 与 3,335 条 caution，R1-SFT 公开 268,211 条已验证 train、210,787 条 incorrect 与 4,439 条 caution。记录形式：版本、style、subset、问题 ID、问题、标准答案、测试与函数元数据、GPT 试验/通过/难度字段、R1 试验/通过/答案字段、对话、lineage 元数据、benchmark 相似度与 caution 原因。文件/存储格式：分片 Parquet。领域/语言：英文 Python 任务，覆盖十二类从基础函数到竞赛编程与包文档的内容。构造与筛选：多种 generator 写题，GPT-4o 写答案和测试，pytest/stdio 执行与分支覆盖验收，测试再拒绝失败的 R1 回答。许可/访问限制：公开且无需审批，采用 CC BY-NC 4.0；代码为 Apache-2.0，上游 seed 条款仍需复核。预期用途：SFT 与以测试为 reward 的 RL。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Synthesize diverse questions. Generate twelve subsets with prefilling, GPT-4o expansion of assessment seeds, code-to-question conversion, documentation prompts, seven-model Magpie generation, and prior synthetic sets.
  2. Deduplicate and label. Embed questions with all-mpnet-base-v2, remove close within-subset duplicates, classify Python task quality, and retain the targeted algorithm/function-generation records.
  3. Generate executable triplets. GPT-4o-0513 writes a solution and paired unit tests. Execute them with pytest and measure branch coverage; only passing pairs with 100% branch coverage are eligible.
  4. Spend more attempts on hard tasks. Regenerate both solution and tests from scratch up to ten times, never reusing a possibly faulty test. Keep questions with at least one passing pair, label difficulty from pass rate, and discard all-failure questions; 279K original-style triplets remain.
  5. Convert style and build SFT. Rewrite verified tasks into completion or online-judge forms, bringing paper V1 to 447K triplets. DeepSeek-R1 generates three responses for each question, and paired tests select passing CoT/code conversations while retaining incorrect and caution splits in the public release.
  6. Train and evaluate. SFT Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct on 50K or 18K hard records, and run GRPO on 10K triplets with binary all-tests-pass reward. Evaluate on HumanEval(+), MBPP(+), BigCodeBench, and LiveCodeBench.

Reproduction should pin every seed/source revision, generator prompt and model, embedding threshold, execution image, coverage tool, trial result, style conversion, and benchmark-similarity score.

1. 合成多样问题。 通过 prefill、GPT-4o 扩展测评 seed、代码转问题、文档 prompt、七模型 Magpie 生成和既有合成集，得到十二个 subset。
  2. 去重并打标签。 用 all-mpnet-base-v2 嵌入问题，删除 subset 内近重复项，再分类 Python 任务质量，只保留目标算法与函数生成记录。
  3. 生成可执行三元组。 GPT-4o-0513 同时编写答案与单元测试，随后用 pytest 执行并测量分支覆盖；只有成功且达到 100% 分支覆盖的组合才可进入下一步。
  4. 为高难题增加预算。 每次都从头生成新的答案与测试，最多十次，不复用可能错误的旧测试。只要至少一组通过就保留问题，并按通过率标注难度；十次全部失败才删除，最终得到 279K 条原始格式三元组。
  5. 转换格式并构造 SFT。 把通过验证的任务改写成 completion 或 online-judge 格式，使论文 V1 达到 447K 条。DeepSeek-R1 每题生成三份回答，配套测试选择通过的 CoT/代码对话，公开发布同时保留 incorrect 与 caution split。
  6. 训练并评测。 用 50K 或 18K 条 hard 记录对 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct 做 SFT，并在 10K 条三元组上用全测试通过的二元 reward 运行 GRPO；评测 HumanEval(+)、MBPP(+)、BigCodeBench 与 LiveCodeBench。

复现应固定每个 seed/来源 revision、generator prompt 与模型、嵌入阈值、执行镜像、覆盖率工具、每次试验结果、style 转换和 benchmark 相似度。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
1. KODCODE-32B-SFT-Hard-18K averages 61.26 across the paper's five benchmark groups, versus 59.25 for Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct and 59.64 for Bespoke-Stratos-32B. Its BigCodeBench-Complete Hard score is 37.2 versus 31.1 for the same-backbone instruct model; this supports the training value of verified demonstrations, though the comparison also changes training data and post-training.
  1. The verification and selection analyses make the mechanism testable. On externally written tests, 78/80 retained MBPP solutions and 189/190 retained LiveCodeBench-V5 solutions pass. Under matched 10K SFT sizes, the hard subset reaches 39.9 on BigCodeBench-Complete Hard versus 38.5 for random sampling, and removing style-converted data falls to 35.1. Co-generated tests are therefore useful but not infallible, and difficulty/style both affect results.

1. KODCODE-32B-SFT-Hard-18K 在论文五组 benchmark 上平均 61.26，同 backbone 的 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct 为 59.25，Bespoke-Stratos-32B 为 59.64；其 BigCodeBench-Complete Hard 为 37.2，而同 backbone instruct 模型是 31.1。这支持已验证示范的训练价值，但比较同时改变了训练数据和 post-training。
  1. 校验与筛选实验让机制可以单独检查。在外部人工测试上，保留的 MBPP 答案有 78/80 通过，LiveCodeBench-V5 有 189/190 通过。SFT 样本数同为 10K 时，hard 子集在 BigCodeBench-Complete Hard 上为 39.9，随机采样为 38.5；删除 style 转换数据后降至 35.1。同源生成测试有用但并非绝对可靠，难度与格式也都会影响结果。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier synthetic code datasets often release instructions and model answers without executable tests, or reject a question after one failed solution. KodCode changes the auditable record to retain a question, solution, unit tests, branch coverage, up to ten fresh trials, pass-derived difficulty, and a separately verified R1 conversation. ACL Findings acceptance, external-test checks, public failure splits, and strong download/use signals are quality evidence. Synthetic instructions, unit-test generation, and reject sampling are not individually new; the direction signal is combining them into a difficulty-preserving, inspectable post-training dataset. Reuse checks should target shared solution/test errors, seed licenses, benchmark overlap, and the non-commercial data license.

更早的合成编程数据常只发布指令和模型答案，没有可执行测试，或在第一次生成答案失败后直接删除整题。KodCode 改变的是可审计记录：同一条数据保留问题、答案、单元测试、分支覆盖、最多十次新试验、按通过率得到的难度，以及单独验证的 R1 对话。ACL Findings 接收、外部测试复核、公开失败 split 与持续下载信号提供了质量证据。合成指令、单元测试生成和 reject sampling 各自并非新方法；真正的方向信号是把它们组合成保留难题且可检查的 post-training 数据。复用时应检查答案与测试的共享错误、seed 许可、benchmark 重叠和非商业数据许可。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Solutions and tests come from GPT-4o, so they can agree on the same misconception despite passing with full branch coverage. Run hidden human or independently generated tests on each source/difficulty stratum before trusting correctness.
  • Benchmark similarity above 0.95 is flagged, not proof that lower-scoring records are uncontaminated; assessment-seed transformations can preserve problem semantics, terms, and license obligations. Exclude caution records, perform code-aware matching against the intended evaluation set, preserve per-record lineage, and review the CC BY-NC 4.0 plus upstream-source terms before reuse.
  • LiveCodeBench-Hard remains weak because competition-level problems are underrepresented. Inspect per-subset pass rates and avoid claiming broad advanced-programming transfer from average benchmark gains.

• 答案和测试都由 GPT-4o 生成，因此即使执行成功并达到完整分支覆盖，也可能共享同一错误理解。应按来源和难度分层运行人工或独立模型编写的隐藏测试。
  • 相似度超过 0.95 的记录会被标记，但低于阈值并不证明无污染；由测评 seed 改写的问题仍可能保留原语义、条款与许可义务。应删除 caution split，对目标评测做代码感知的语义匹配，保留逐记录 lineage，并在复用前审查 CC BY-NC 4.0 与上游来源条款。
  • LiveCodeBench-Hard 仍然较弱，因为竞赛级高难题覆盖不足。应检查逐 subset 通过率，不能用平均提升声称广泛的高级编程迁移。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• Use R1-SFT when the target is a coding assistant that produces long reasoning and executable solutions; use V1 triplets when training with unit-test reward or generating a new verified SFT target.
  • The input is the chosen question/style plus test metadata when appropriate; the output is a verified conversation or code solution, and success is all tests passing plus improvement over a matched base model on held-out code benchmarks.
  • Preserve question ID, subset, seed IDs, every trial, coverage, selected solution, test, benchmark similarity, R1 pass sequence, split, and dataset revision. Do not use the release when commercial licensing or independently authored tests are mandatory.

• 目标是训练输出长推理与可执行答案的编程助手时使用 R1-SFT；需要单元测试 reward 或重新生成训练 target 时使用 V1 三元组。
  • 输入是选定的问题/style，并在适用时加入测试元数据；输出是已验证对话或代码答案。成功标准是全部测试通过，并在保留的代码 benchmark 上优于匹配 base model。
  • 应保留问题 ID、subset、seed ID、全部 trial、覆盖率、选中答案、测试、benchmark 相似度、R1 通过序列、split 与数据 revision。不适合必须商业许可或必须使用独立作者测试的场景。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Paper V1 contains 447K verified question-solution-test triplets across twelve source families; current V1.1 counts are larger.
  2. GPT-4o regenerates solution and tests together up to ten times, and acceptance requires execution plus 100% branch coverage.
  3. DeepSeek-R1 receives three attempts per question; the public SFT data separates 268,211 verified records from 210,787 incorrect ones.
  4. External tests catch residual self-verification errors: 78/80 MBPP and 189/190 LiveCodeBench retained solutions pass.
  5. The data is CC BY-NC 4.0, while code is Apache-2.0; caution and provenance fields should remain attached in reuse.

1. 论文 V1 在十二类来源上共有 447K 条已验证问题、答案、测试三元组；当前 V1.1 的数量更大。
  2. GPT-4o 最多同时重写答案与测试十次，接受条件是执行成功且达到 100% 分支覆盖。
  3. DeepSeek-R1 每题有三次尝试；公开 SFT 把 268,211 条已验证记录与 210,787 条错误记录分开。
  4. 外部测试仍发现少量自验证错误：MBPP 为 78/80 通过，LiveCodeBench 为 189/190 通过。
  5. 数据采用 CC BY-NC 4.0，代码采用 Apache-2.0；复用时必须保留 caution 与 provenance 字段。

value.html: Paper V1 has 447K records over Prefill, Leetcode, Codeforces, Apps, Taco, Code Contests, Algorithm, Data Structure, Docs, Filter, Package, and Evol; current V1.1 counts differ because online-judge records were added.

value_zh.html: 论文 V1 有 447K 条记录，覆盖 Prefill、Leetcode、Codeforces、Apps、Taco、Code Contests、Algorithm、Data Structure、Docs、Filter、Package 与 Evol；当前 V1.1 计数不同，因为加入了 online-judge 记录。

value.html: Current KodCode-V1 exposes 484,097 train and 3,335 use-with-caution records; KodCode-V1-SFT-R1 exposes 268,211 verified train, 210,787 incorrect, and 4,439 use-with-caution records.

value_zh.html: 当前 KodCode-V1 公开 484,097 条 train 与 3,335 条 use-with-caution 记录；KodCode-V1-SFT-R1 公开 268,211 条已验证 train、210,787 条不正确与 4,439 条 use-with-caution 记录。

value.html: Questions are compared by all-mpnet-base-v2 cosine similarity to HumanEval, MBPP, BigCodeBench, and LiveCodeBench; high-similarity records are flagged rather than silently treated as clean.

value_zh.html: 问题用 all-mpnet-base-v2 余弦相似度与 HumanEval、MBPP、BigCodeBench 和 LiveCodeBench 比较；高相似记录被标记，而非静默视为干净。

items: Solutions and tests are generated by the same model, so 100% self-test coverage can still encode a shared misconception; external MBPP/LiveCodeBench checks found small residual errors.
Some records exceed a 0.95 benchmark-similarity threshold, and seed-derived questions may preserve semantic overlap below that cutoff.
Hard competitive-programming questions remain underrepresented, with limited gains on LiveCodeBench-Hard.
解答与测试由同一模型生成，因此 100% 自测覆盖仍可能编码共享误解；外部 MBPP/LiveCodeBench 检查发现少量残余错误。
部分记录超过 0.95 基准相似度阈值，且源自种子的问题可能在该截止值以下仍保留语义重叠。
困难竞赛编程问题仍代表性不足，在 LiveCodeBench-Hard 上增益有限。

value.html: Data releases declare CC BY-NC 4.0; the generation code is Apache-2.0, and inherited seeds and documentation still require source-level review.

value_zh.html: 数据发布声明 CC BY-NC 4.0；生成代码为 Apache-2.0，继承的种子与文档仍需来源级审查。
